# Indian Calisthenics School

> Calisthenics academy in Madhapur, Hyderabad (Image Hospital Road, adjacent to Fresh Living Apartment, Vittal Rao Nagar, Hyderabad 500081), near Mindspace and HITEC City. Group batches from complete beginner to advanced, The Mighty Tribe kids program (ages 3–15: calisthenics, gymnastics and parkour), personal and online coaching, freestyle calisthenics and parkour. Founded by Aman Bisht, national calisthenics champion who has represented India. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 88267 62234.

## Key facts
- Weekday adult batches: Mon–Fri 6:30–9:30 AM and 6–9 PM (one-hour slots), ₹7,777/month (₹22,222 quarterly, ₹44,444 half-yearly, ₹77,777 yearly)
- Weekend adult batch: Sat–Sun 8–10 AM, ₹4,444/month
- Kids (The Mighty Tribe, ages 3–15): weekdays 4–6 PM ₹5,555/month; weekends 9–10 AM ₹3,333/month
- Demo: free on weekdays; weekend demo ₹800, adjusted in the package on joining
- Online personal training ₹15,000; in-person personal training priced after consultation
- Sister academy: Calisthenics Lab India, Kondapur (https://www.calisthenicslabindia.club/)

- [About](https://www.indiancalisthenicsschool.com/about): the academy and its founder
- [Aman Bisht, founder](https://www.indiancalisthenicsschool.com/aman-bisht): calisthenics athlete and coach from Dehradun, based in Hyderabad. 3× national champion, represented India three times (Italy 2023, Russia 2024, Asian Championship of Freestyle in Mumbai, 2024: third in Asia). Judges calisthenics competitions across India. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gravity_antagonist_sw. Began coaching in Dehradun around 2019, free of charge; founded Hyderabad Calisthenics, Indian Calisthenics School and Calisthenics Lab India
